result:
The round 18 fix (TM-B21, D-27) is in: sorting by Artist or Genre no longer throws when an array's first element isn't a string. The full gate passed locally. I did not run R18-5, the real-app sort check, so C still has to.

**The fix.** In `src/renderer/src/stores/file-store.ts` I added a small private helper, `getFieldSortKey`. For an array it uses the first element only if it is a string, otherwise `''`. Everything else still goes through `String(value ?? '')`. Both sides of the comparison use it. It is not exported, adds no cast, comment or `file-row-display` import, and leaves the other sort paths untouched.

**Tests.** Only the three owned files changed, all modified and nothing untracked. In the tests, the only lines removed are two import lines, each extended with a new name (`WavMetadata`, `fireEvent`).
- `tests/renderer/stores/file-store.test.ts`: 10 new tests:
  - (a) four malformed first elements;
  - (b) `[{}, "Mid"]`;
  - (c) five checks on well-typed data.

  Each runs in both insertion orders and both sort directions.
- `tests/renderer/components/file-list.test.ts`: one new test (R18-e) clicks the Artist header twice and checks the row order each way.

| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| Red, before the fix | 6 failed, 30 passed. (a), (b) and (R18-e) failed with `TypeError: aStr.localeCompare is not a function`; all five (c) checks passed. |
| Green, after the fix | 36/36 |
| Full `verifyCommand` | exit 0: Biome 0 errors and the same 9 warnings as before, typecheck 0 (including `tsconfig.test.json`), renderer 146/146 (135 + 11), main 93/93, E2E 7/7 |
| `playwright test --retries=0` | 7/7 |
| Mutants M1–M5, in a throwaway copy under `/tmp` | all five killed |

**Reviews (both read-only).**
- **code-reviewer:** no defects or rule violations. Its one note: `[5]` and `[{}]` would sort the same if the code wrongly turned them into text, so only the `[true]` case catches that mistake. I kept `[{}]` in R18-e because the task prescribes it and it really did fail before the fix.
- **qa-engineer:** no regressions. It confirmed M1–M4 independently.

**Process.** The read-primitives hook did not fire again, so A-R17-02 stays open for root. I read the four required primitives before the first edit, and every repository write went through Edit or Write.

**Gaps I logged for B** (outside this round's scope):
- **A-R18-01:** a non-array malformed object whose `toString` isn't callable still throws. D-27 deliberately leaves that path unchanged.
- **A-R18-02:** only the `[true]` case catches the text-conversion mutant, and that depends on the collation order.

Tests are still not linted by Biome (TM-B06).

**Acceptance.** I passed R18-2, R18-3 (self-check only) and R18-4. The ownership part of R18-1 looks right. R18-5 was not run, so realVerified is false from my side.

The report is in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/tag-manager-loop/a-round-18.md` and the logs, diffs and checkpoint are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/tag-manager-loop/a-round-18/`.
